description: This Java class facilitates SQLite schema migration within a Spring Boot application. It checks if the 'users' table exists and adds the 'avatar' column if missing, ensuring schema compatibility with current entity mappings.

classes.name: SqliteSchemaMigration
classes.description: A Spring component that runs at application startup to perform schema migrations on a SQLite database, specifically adding missing columns to the 'users' table.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Entry point after application startup; triggers the migration process.

methods.name: migrateUsersTable
methods.description: Performs checks on the 'users' table and adds the 'avatar' column if it's absent.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a specified table exists in the SQLite database.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves a set of column names for a specified table.
